name: Ron Wyden

issue_poll.name: Emerson College Oregon poll, Oct 31–Nov 1, 2022, combined with DHM Research Oregon likely-voter panel, Aug 6–11, 2022
issue_poll.note: Emerson published only its top 5 issues; shares averaged with DHM most-important-issue results (https://www.opb.org/pdf/DHM%20Panel--August%202022_1663262770488.pdf) where both asked, DHM alone otherwise. Homelessness also ranked first in OVBC's Sept 2022 survey.

issues.position: Restore and expand the child tax credit

votes.bill_title: Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act
votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

votes.bill_title: One Big Beautiful Bill Act (Bennet motion to commit to expand child tax credit)
votes.question: On the motion to commit with instructions

issues.position: National vote by mail (Vote at Home Act); cap polling-place waits
issues.note: Vote at Home Act never got a floor vote; rated on SAVE America Act, which he said would burden mail voting.

issues.position: Pass the DASH Act: housing vouchers and affordable-housing funding
issues.note: No floor vote on the DASH Act or a voucher expansion this term.

issues.position: Pass federal protections for abortion access and interstate travel

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.position: Permanent Medicaid funding for CAHOOTS-style crisis responders
issues.note: No floor vote on permanent mobile-crisis funding this term.

issues.position: Touted Inflation Reduction Act clean-energy credits; no forward pledge found
Extend lower insulin costs to people with private insurance
issues.note: No floor vote on a private-insurance insulin cap this term.

issues.position: Universal background checks; assault weapons ban; raise purchase age to 21
issues.note: No recorded floor vote on these measures this term.

issues.position: Annual tax on billionaires' gains (Billionaires Income Tax)
issues.note: No floor vote on a billionaires tax this term.

issues.position: Surtax on oil company profits; higher tax on stock buybacks
issues.note: No floor vote on an oil-profits surtax or buyback tax increase this term.

caveats: Issue ranking combines two polls; Emerson's homelessness/housing share was not published, so DHM's 13% was used.
Child tax credit release is undated (Census poverty-data day); a Nov 15, 2022 Law360 report confirms the same stance just after the election.
Several positions come from official Senate statements in 2022, not campaign materials; his campaign site archive could not be reached.
Votes on H.R.1 motion to commit (RC 354) and SAVE America Act taken from patterns in other senators' verified files, not a Wyden-specific source; pending automatic senate.gov check.
